title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Scorned Wilderness Dragontail Vines Guide
author: Jacob Fox
description:
Welcome to Dragontail Vines, the first section of the Scorned Wilderness in RuneScape: Dragonwilds!

Dragontail Vines is the first area you'll encounter when making your way through the Scorned Wilderness, eventually leading toward Kuldra's Sanctum.

Right off the bat, you'll be facing a Black Dragon. After that initial fight, the enemies become much less intense, with groups of enemies like Zombies standing between you and the Anima puzzles scattered throughout the area.

The Scorned Wilderness is made up of Level 8 areas, with Level 9 boss mobs sprinkled throughout. If you're preparing to explore the region, it's recommended that you first farm Rune and Luminite Ore to craft Rune gear. From there, you can farm Magic Trees and Vis to work toward higher-level armor and weapons.

That said, I went through Dragontail Vines wearing a full set of Obsidian armor and didn't have too many issues, so you don't necessarily need the highest-level gear to start exploring.

This is the first of four detailed guides covering each section of the Scorned Wilderness. Once all four sections are covered, I'll combine them into one complete Scorned Wilderness guide.

The Scorned Wilderness is part of the RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 launch and introduces the game's newest major region.

Don't forget to subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, gameplay, updates, and everything happening in Ashenfall!
